mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, signaling broader demand weakness that predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105), robust supply chains support corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 95), supply chain disruptions reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
